snippet.title: Flow Skate // SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
SAGE Booth ► https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/flow-skate-first-time-trial-demo.2622/

Introducing Flow Skate, a fast-paced 3D platformer with gameplay inspired by Sonic R and Kirby Air Ride, with a sharp cel-shaded aesthetic.
